SessionStart.command: echo '{"systemMessage": "SDLC Pipeline active. Current artifacts: $(ls requirements.md architecture.md design-review.md impl-plan.md 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' ' || echo none). Gate approval is REQUIRED before each phase transition. Never skip gates."}'
SessionStart.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$artifacts = @('requirements.md','architecture.md','design-review.md','impl-plan.md') | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ }; $msg = if ($artifacts) { $artifacts -join ', ' } else { 'none' }; Write-Output ('{\"systemMessage\": \"SDLC Pipeline active. Existing artifacts: ' + $msg + '. Gate approval REQUIRED before each phase transition. Never skip gates.\"}')"

SubagentStart.command: echo '{"systemMessage": "Subagent starting. Remember: output a gate message after phase completes and STOP — do not auto-proceed."}'
SubagentStart.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Write-Output '{\"systemMessage\": \"Subagent starting. Remember: output a gate message after phase completes and STOP — do not auto-proceed.\"}'"

SubagentStop.command: echo '{"systemMessage": "Subagent complete. Present the gate message to the user and await explicit approval before proceeding."}'
SubagentStop.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Write-Output '{\"systemMessage\": \"Subagent complete. Present the gate message to the user and await explicit approval before proceeding.\"}'"
